summary: Dime Community Bancshares filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a quarterly cash dividend on its Series A preferred stock. The board declared $0.34375 per share, payable May 15, 2026, to holders of record May 8, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, delisting, or capital return event is involved. The filing includes only the dividend press release as an exhibit. No deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. This is a standard current report of an ordinary preferred dividend, warranting no special-situations classification.
